facts.meaning: Default registration order is shiny-switch, Safari/Contest IV reroll, flagged-species perfect-IV guarantee, map-flag level scaling. Reroll declines only when both mode queries are false. Up to four iterations first check whether any current IV equals IV_STAT_LIMIT; absent a perfect IV, each main stat rerandomizes in that iteration. calc_stats runs afterward only if at least one reroll occurred. Existing perfect IV skips rerolls. Later guarantee requires configured enable flag and Legendary/Mythical/UltraBeast effective data flag, samples three main stats and writes their IV maximum then recalculates. Scaling requires ScaleWildEncounterLevels and changes clamped level, recalculates stats and resets moves. These are conditional notification consumers, bypassed by direct NPC constructor.
